Name: CHR_PROXY_PHYSICS_PARAM_ST
Description: Havok character proxy collision settings. A row can override the default values for a specific map, collision hit or asset (see Map ID and the part name fields).

Fields.Name: Penetration Recovery Speed
Fields.Description: Speed at which a character that has sunk into collision is pushed back out. Too large a value makes the character jitter or get thrown away; too small a value can let it fall through the collision.

Fields.Name: Keep Contact Tolerance
Fields.Description: Clearance distance. It sets the range in which contacts are detected, so a larger value reduces tunnelling (falling through collision). Too large a value costs performance.

Fields.Name: Map ID
Fields.Description: MapUid the parameter override applies to. -1: default values.

Fields.Name: Hit Part Name
Fields.Description: Collision hit the override applies to: the 123456 part of h123456_7890. Matches the hit the character stands directly on. -1: not specified.

Fields.Name: Reference Hit Part Name
Fields.Description: Reference collision hit the override applies to: the 123456 part of h123456_7890. Matches an asset's reference hit. -1: not specified.

Fields.Name: Asset Part Name
Fields.Description: Asset the override applies to: the 123456 part of AEG123_456_7890. -1: not specified.
